message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Release Python
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  macos:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
          architecture: arm64
      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          default: true
      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: Build wheels - x86_64
        uses: messense/maturin-action@v1
        with:
          target: x86_64
          args: --release --out dist --sdist -m autocorrect-py/Cargo.toml
      - name: Build wheels - aarch64
        uses: messense/maturin-action@v1
        with:
          target: aarch64
          args: --release --out dist -m autocorrect-py/Cargo.toml
      - name: Upload wheels
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wheels-macos
          path: dist

  windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        target: [x64, x86]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
          architecture: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          default: true
      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: Build wheels
        uses: messense/maturin-action@v1
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          args: --release --out dist -m autocorrect-py/Cargo.toml
      - name: Upload wheels
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wheels-windows-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist

  linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        target: [x86_64, i686]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
          architecture: x64
      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: Build wheels
        uses: messense/maturin-action@v1
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          manylinux: auto
          args: --release --out dist -m autocorrect-py/Cargo.toml
      - name: Upload wheels
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wheels-linux-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist

  linux-cross:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        target: [aarch64, armv7, s390x, ppc64le]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: Build wheels
        uses: messense/maturin-action@v1
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          manylinux: auto
          args: --release --out dist -m autocorrect-py/Cargo.toml
      - name: Upload wheels
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wheels-linux-cross-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist

  musllinux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        target:
          - x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
          - i686-unknown-linux-musl
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
          architecture: x64
      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: Build wheels
        uses: messense/maturin-action@v1
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          manylinux: musllinux_1_2
          args: --release --out dist -m autocorrect-py/Cargo.toml
      - name: Upload wheels
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wheels-musllinux-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist

  musllinux-cross:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        platform:
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            arch: aarch64
          - target: armv7-unknown-linux-musleabihf
            arch: armv7
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: Build wheels
        uses: messense/maturin-action@v1
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.platform.target }}
          manylinux: musllinux_1_2
          args: --release --out dist -m autocorrect-py/Cargo.toml
      - name: Upload wheels
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wheels-musllinux-cross-${{ matrix.platform.target }}
          path: dist

  publish:
    name: Publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [macos, windows, linux, linux-cross, musllinux, musllinux-cross]
    steps:
      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: wheels-*
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
      - name: Publish to PyPI
        env:
          TWINE_USERNAME: __token__
          TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PYPI_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade twine
          twine upload --skip-existing *
",
  "rationale": "The workflow builds Rust-based Python wheels across multiple platforms using maturin. Each job downloads the Rust toolchain and fetches Cargo dependencies from scratch. Adding GitHub Actions caching for the Cargo registry (~/.cargo/registry) and git dependencies (~/.cargo/git) keyed by Cargo.lock avoids repeated dependency downloads on subsequent workflow runs. This applies the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) which is supported by literature (S01, Table 4) and experimental evidence showing ~51% elapsed-time savings for Maven dependency caching (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2) and similar pip caching benefits (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2). The change preserves all build targets, test coverage, and artifact outputs while only inserting cache steps before the maturin build. The checkout action is also pinned to a specific SHA (v7.0.1) for supply-chain security.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
